name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 57 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2025-11-24, at wavelengths from 1.67 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
